latestVona.title: Semeru - 20261023/2334Z
latestVona.text: Eruption with volcanic ash cloud at 2334 UTC (0634 local). Best estimate of ash-cloud top is around 14963 FT (4676 M) above sea level or 3200 FT (1000 M) above summit. May be higher than what can be observed clearly. Source of height data: ground observer. Ash cloud moving to southeast. Volcanic ash is observed to be white to gray. The intensity of volcanic ash is observed to be thick..
